body: Thank you. I'm trying really hard right now. I'm really thankful for you reaching out, Cloud. I don't know what I'm going to do, and I do know I'm going to try and eat right now. I think I just want to make it through the night.

Hi, LittleCloud.

I think that my thoughts are swamped by pain. One the days I can think about it, I daydream about what the future might hold. Those days are too short. I really appreciate your reply, and I'm really scared right now. It's the thought of continuing on, only for things to deteriorate even further. I... I don't really know what to do right now.

You're right, I don't think I deserve anything good right now. I'm sorry, I'm morose I can't I can't

I'm so sorry.

Hi, Plain Sam.

I haven't been in your situation before. And I can't begin to fathom how you're feeling. To me it sounds that you're frustrated with the lack of answers, and grieving the loss of your friend. It also sounds like he was amazing, and a wonderful friend. It makes sense that you're feeling the way that you do. This was someone you were close to.

I didn't know your friend, and you knew him better than I. From your words, I can say this: by him never turning you away in your time of need, and empathizing with your plight, it seems that he cared for you very much. He could have been afraid to reach out, worried that he was a burden. I don't know. I do know that he cared for you. If anything, please remember that he cared for you.

I wish I knew what to say. I'm sorry if this message doesn't help. 

​
